verdict.rationale: Scheduled or background actions are a fair question for an online tax-filing and payment service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no user-configurable automations that run autonomously. MeF and IRIS A2A are credentialed machine-to-machine transmission channels, which are developer building blocks rather than an automation feature. The EFTPS and Direct Pay entries are bare titles with no evidence of scheduling or recurring runs, and the EIN assistant is an interactive session that times out after 15 minutes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
